findings.summary: U2 pin TMR (__unnamed_37) missing pull-up resistor

findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_37 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin TMR is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
